title: Signature Composite Index
description: Signature Composite Index is a analysis ability in the Signature Ecosystem Health Indexing database. Combines dozens of signals into one 0–100 health index. Signals are normalized and weighted; the index is the weighted mean. It takes signals and produces index. Tunable parameters: 0–100. Guarantee: the index is always explainable by its parts. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.
